notes.title: Game OPEN NOW!
notes.notes:
Hello!

We're thrilled to announce the launch of the CardAttack Roguelike game service!

We hope you have a fantastic time playing! If you happen to encounter any bugs or have suggestions that could help improve the game, please don't hesitate to let us know. Your feedback is always welcome.

Ready to start your adventure?
